note: The remaining levels use the same runtime family pools with theme-specific background/story palettes in GameRoot until more hand-authored per-level object slicing is added.

globalRules.background: bitmap base plus procedural parallax, atmosphere and object-pack sprites
globalRules.platforms: object-pack platform sprite first, procedural collider/readability fallback second
globalRules.obstacles: object-pack hazard sprite first, obstacle-specific procedural silhouette and anchored Russian label second
globalRules.labels: 1-2 lines, larger phone-readable text, physical plate carrier, strong stroke/shadow
globalRules.bonusVisualStates: bonus icon + visible equipment on player
globalRules.performanceBudget: object sprites are pooled, labels are pooled, particles are capped
